questions.question: The distance between the centres of two equal circle each of radius 4 cm is 17 cm. The length of a transverse tangent is:
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Radius of 1st circle = 4 cm

Radius of 2ⁿd circle = 4 cm

Distance between the centres of two circles = 17 cm

**Formula used: **

(Length of transverse tangent)² = [(distance between the centres)² – (r₁ + r₂)²]

Where r₁ and r₂ are the radii of two circles.

**Calculation: **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ae61862090534045df8109d6fcc36b43feb74674c3c85b07b261b2b6fea6402.png] 

Let the transverse tangent be PQ and distance between the centres be AB

Let r₁ and r₂ be the radii of the circles

According to the formula

⇒ (PQ)² = (AB)² – (r₁ + r₂)²

⇒ (PQ)² = (17)² – (4 + 4)²

⇒ (PQ)² = 289 – 64

⇒ (PQ)² = 225

⇒ PQ = √225

⇒ PQ = 15 cm

**∴**** The length of a transverse tangent is 15 cm**

questions.question: A car covered 150 km in 5 hours. If it travels at one-third its usual speed, then how much more time will it take to cover the same distance?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Distance covered by car = 150 km

Time taken by the car = 5 hours

**Formula used: **

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation: **

Speed of car = 150/5

⇒ Speed of car = 30 km/h

According to the question, if he travels at 1/3rd of its usual speed then

⇒ Speed = 30/3 km/h

⇒ Speed = 10 km/h

⇒ Time taken to travel 150 km at reduced speed = 150/10 hours

⇒ Time taken to travel 150 km at reduced speed = 15 hours

⇒ Increase in time = (15 – 5) hours

⇒ Increase in time 10 hours

**∴ It will take 10 hours more to cover same distance if speed gets reduced to 1/3rd its usual speed. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

As per the question,

Speed ratio = 3:1

Time ratio = 1:3 

Given 1 unit = 5 hour so 3 unit = 15 hour 

Increase in time = (15 – 5) hours = 10 hours

questions.question: The printed price on a book is Rs. 150. If it is sold after two successive discounts of 30% and 40%, then find its selling price.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Marked price of book = Rs. 150

1st discount = 30%

2ⁿd discount = 40%

**Formula used: **

Discount = Marked price – Selling price

Discount % = Discount/Marked price × 100

When 2 discounts are given,

Net discount = (D₁ + D₂ – D₁D₂/100)%

Where, D₁ = Discount 1

D₂ = Discount 2

**Calculation:**

Net discount = (D₁ + D₂ – D₁D₂/100)%

Net Discount = [30 + 40 – (30)(40)/100]%

⇒ Net Discount = (70 – 12)

⇒ Net Discount = 58% 

Discount % = Discount/Marked price × 100

⇒ 58% = Discount/150 × 100

⇒ Discount = 58 × 150/100 = 87 

Discount = Marked price – Selling price

⇒ 87 = 150 – Selling price

⇒ Selling Price = Rs. 63

**∴ Its selling price is Rs. 63

questions.question: If 2cot theta = 3, then frac{{sqrt {13} cos theta - 3tan theta }}{{3tan theta + sqrt {13} sin theta }} is:
questions.solution:
**Given: **

2cotθ = 3 

**Formula used: **

Sinθ = P/H 

Cosθ = B/H 

Tanθ = P/B 

Cotθ = B/P 

H2 = P2 + B2

where P = Perpendicular 

B = Base 

H = Height 

**Calculation: **

2cotθ = 3 

⇒ cotθ = 3/2 

on comparing with (Cotθ = B/P), we get 

⇒ B = 3

⇒ P = 2 

According to Pythagorean theorem

⇒ H² = P² + B²

⇒ H2 = 22 + 32

⇒ H = √13 

⇒ Sinθ = 2/√13 

⇒ Cosθ = 3/√13 

⇒ Tanθ = 2/3 

Putting all the above values in equation frac{{sqrt {13} cos theta - 3tan theta }}{{3tan theta + sqrt {13} sin theta }}

⇒ frac{{sqrt {13} (3/sqrt13) - 3(2/3) }}{{3(2/3) + sqrt {13} (2/ sqrt {13}) }}

⇒ (3 - 2)/(2 + 2) = 1/4 

**∴ The value of frac{{sqrt {13} cos theta - 3tan theta }}{{3tan theta + sqrt {13} sin theta }}is 1/4.**

questions.question: If {x⁴} + (1)/({{x⁴)}} = 14159, then the value of x + (1)/(x) is:
questions.solution:
**Given: **

**{x⁴} + (1)/({{x⁴)}} = 14159** 

**Formula used: **

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab 

**Calculation: **

x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 14159

Adding 2 on both sides, 

⇒ x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2 = 14159 + 2

⇒ (x² + 1/x²)² = 14161

Taking square root both sides

⇒ (x² + 1/x²) = √(14161)

⇒ (x² + 1/x²) = 119

Adding 2 on both sides, 

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2 = 119 + 2

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 121

Taking square root both sides

⇒ x + 1/x = √121

⇒ x + 1/x = 11

**∴**** The value of x + 1/x is 11.**

questions.question: In a question on division,the divisor is 6 times the quotient and 3 times the remainder. If the remainder is 40, then find the dividend.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The divisor is 6 times the quotient and 3 times the reminder

The reminder = 40

**Formula used:**

Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Reminder

**Calculation:**

Divisor = 3 × Reminder 

⇒ Divisor = 3 × 40 = 120

Quotient = (1/6) × Divisor

⇒ Quotient = (1/6) × 120 = 20

Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Reminder

⇒ 120 × 20 + 40

⇒ 2400 + 40

⇒ 2440

**∴ The dividend is 2440.**

 ∠ZYL + ∠YZL + ∠YLZ = 180°

⇒ ∠YZL = 50°

questions.question: The average of 40 numbers is 36. The average of the first 25 numbers is 31 and the average of last 16 numbers is 43. Find the 25th number.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

An average of 40 numbers = 36

average of the first 25 numbers = 31

Average of last 16 numbers = 43

**Calculation:**

⇒ {(31 × 25) + (16 × 43)} – (40 × 36)

⇒ {775 + 688} – 1440

⇒ 1463 – 1440

⇒ 23

**∴ The 25th number is 23. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** 

GIven average = 36 

Missing number. = average + (higher avg. - avg ) × carry a higher average of candidate - (avg - lower avg) × carry a lower average of the candidate 

So, the 25th number. = 36 + (43 - 36) 16 - (36 - 31) 25

⇒ 36 + 112 - 125 = 23

questions.question: The area of the quadrant of a circle whose circumference is 22 cm, will be;
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Circumference of the circle = 22 cm

**Formula used:**

Circumference = 2πr

Area of a circle = πr²

Area of the quadrant = (πr2 × 1/4)

r = Radius of the circle

**Calculation:**

2πr = 22

⇒ πr = 11

⇒ 22/7 × r = 11

⇒ r = 3.5

Area of the circle = πr²

⇒ 22/7 × 7/2 × 7/2

⇒ 154/4

⇒ Area of the quadrant = 154/4 × 1/4

⇒ 154/16

⇒ 9.625

⇒ Area of the quadrant = 9.625 cm²

**∴ Area of the quadrant is 9.625 cm²**

questions.question: How much will be decreased to each terms of raio 16 : 19, so that it will be 7 : 6?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial ratio = 16 : 19

Ratio after decrease = 7 : 6

**Concept used:**

(1st number – x) : (2nd number – x) = Ratio after decrease

**Calculation:**

Let x be decreased from each terms

(16 – x)/(19 – x) = 7/6

⇒ 96 – 6x = 133 – 7x

⇒ 7x – 6x = 133 – 96

⇒ x = 37

**∴ Required answer is 37**

questions.question: Suresh lent out a sum of money to Rakesh for 5 years at simple interest. At the end of 5 years, Rakesh paid 9/8 of the sum to suresh to clear out the amount. Find the rate of simple interest per annum.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total amount = 9/8 of the sum to suresh

Time = 5 year

**Formula used:**

Simple interest = (Principal amount × rate of interest × time)/100

**Calculation:**

Let the principal and rate of interest be P and R

Total amount = 9P/8

Simple interest = (9P/8) – P = P/8

S.I. = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ P/8 = (P × R × 5)/100

⇒ 1/8 = R/20

⇒ R = 20/8

⇒ R = 2.5%

**∴**** The rate of simple interest is 2.5%.**
